قسم صيانة التربينة بعمل الصيانة المطلوبة على كراسى التربينة حيث يتم فك جميع

الانتظار فترة كافية بعد الخروج بالوحدة لحين انخفاض درجة حرارة عامود التربينة 
 الى درجة حرارة 50 درجة مئوية تقريبا

اصدار امر شغل معتمد من قسم التشغيل بالمحطة موقع عليه من فنيين قسم صيانة

 لامر الشغل المعتمد من رئيس قسم صيانة الاجهزة

يتم تسجيل فئة 
 السلامة والصحة المهنية لكل الافراد العاملين بأمر الشغل

يتم التأكد من ايقاف طلمبات الزيت الموجود على التربينة وذلك بعد فصل التغذية 
 عنها جهد 380 فولت تيار متردد وجهد 110 فولت تيار ثابت
يتم التأكد من ايقاف عامود الدورات البطيئة للتربينة

sections_en.text: This document sets out the steps of the periodic maintenance procedures on the turbine instruments after the unit is taken out of service, at the request of the turbine maintenance department to carry out the required maintenance on the turbine bearings, during which all the measuring instruments on the bearings on which the turbine maintenance department carries out maintenance are removed.

The document was prepared by Eng. Ayman Mohamed Abdel Meguid, reviewed and tested by Eng. Mohamed Abdel Mohsen Mohamed, endorsed by Eng. Abdel Azim Gomaa Hagras, General Manager of Assiut Thermal Station, approved by Mr. Eng. Hussein Ahmed El-Mahdy, Head of Sector, and certified by Mr. Eng. Gamal El-Din Abdel Wahab, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector and MPIS Coordinator for the company.

items: Wait a sufficient period after taking the unit out of service until the turbine shaft temperature drops to approximately 50 °C

Issue a work order approved by the station operations department, signed by the instrument maintenance department technicians assigned to carry out the maintenance work, under the supervision of the maintenance engineer executing the work order approved by the head of the instrument maintenance department
Record the occupational safety and health category of all personnel working on the work order
Make sure the oil pumps on the turbine are stopped, after disconnecting their supply: 380 VAC and 110 Vdc
Make sure the turbine slow-speed shaft is stopped

rows: Remove the instruments on bearings No. (1), (2), (3), (4) at the request of the turbine department
Remove the vibration transmitter (sensor) on bearing No. (1)
Remove the thermometer for the steam temperature entering the turbine
Remove the two thermocouples for measuring the oil temperature of bearing (1) (front and rear)
Remove thermometers 0-200 °C, 0-100 °C for measuring the bearing metal temperature
Remove the (2) sensors for turbine vibration
Remove the (2) thermocouples for oil temperature
Remove the thermometer for steam temperature
Remove the thermometer on bearing No. 2, western side, 0-100 °C
Remove the generator cooling air thermometer, eastern side, 0-100 °C
Remove the (2) thermocouples for oil temperature
Remove a thermocouple for measuring the oil temperature
Refit all the measuring instruments removed from bearings (1), (2), (3), (4) in the same positions as before removal

Adjust the displacement measuring instrument by adjusting the locking nut of the displacement sensor, measuring the voltage of the displacement converter so that it gives half the 24 Vdc supply voltage, and making sure it gives the correct value (0 mm) on the recorder in the thermal control room, after the turbine maintenance department has mechanically adjusted the turbine shaft position

Adjust the vibration measuring instruments on the turbine bearings by adjusting the locking nut on the vibration sensor, measuring the voltage of the vibration converter for each bearing so that it gives half the 24 Vdc supply voltage, and making sure it gives the correct value (0 micrometres) on the recorder in the thermal control room
Reconnect the supply voltage: 380 VAC, 110 Vdc

Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedures Information System
Maintenance Procedures Information System
 | Instrumentation and Control | Maintenance procedures
Document No.:
MI-002-r0a | Equipment:
Instruments on turbine No. (2)
ABB
Issued to:
Assiut
3 x 30 MW
Status:
Approved
Approval date:
25 March 2007 | Procedure:
Instrument adjustment
Next review date:
March 2012
Introduction
This document sets out the steps of the periodic maintenance procedures on the turbine instruments after the unit is taken out of service, at the request of the turbine maintenance department to carry out the required maintenance on the turbine bearings, during which all the measuring instruments on the bearings on which the turbine maintenance department carries out maintenance are removed.
The document was prepared by Eng. Ayman Mohamed Abdel Meguid, reviewed and tested by Eng. Mohamed Abdel Mohsen Mohamed, endorsed by Eng. Abdel Azim Gomaa Hagras, General Manager of Assiut Thermal Station, approved by Mr. Eng. Hussein Ahmed El-Mahdy, Head of Sector, and certified by Mr. Eng. Gamal El-Din Abdel Wahab, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector and MPIS Coordinator for the company.
Safety precautions
Wait a sufficient period after taking the unit out of service until the turbine shaft temperature drops to approximately 50 °C
Issue a work order approved by the station operations department, signed by the instrument maintenance department technicians assigned to carry out the maintenance work, under the supervision of the maintenance engineer executing the work order approved by the head of the instrument maintenance department
Record the occupational safety and health category of all personnel working on the work order
Make sure the oil pumps on the turbine are stopped, after disconnecting their supply: 380 VAC and 110 Vdc
Make sure the turbine slow-speed shaft is stopped
Tools and equipment used
Allen key set, various sizes
Spanners 24/27, 30/32
Spanner 16/17
Avometer for measurement
Ordinary pliers, 8 inch
Needle-nose pliers, small adjustable spanner
Ordinary side cutters, hammer
Allen key set, various sizes
Spanners 24/27, 30/32
Spanner 16/17
Avometer for measurement
Ordinary pliers, 8 inch
Needle-nose pliers, small adjustable spanner
Ordinary side cutters, hammer
Procedures to be carried out
Remove the instruments on bearings No. (1), (2), (3), (4) at the request of the turbine department | 1.
Remove the speed instruments | 2.
Remove the displacement transmitter (sensor) | 3.
Remove the vibration transmitter (sensor) on bearing No. (1) | 4.
Remove the thermometer for the steam temperature entering the turbine | 5.
Remove the two thermocouples for measuring the oil temperature of bearing (1) (front and rear) | 6.
Remove thermometers 0-200 °C, 0-100 °C for measuring the bearing metal temperature | 7.
For bearing No. (1)
Remove the displacement (sensor) | 1.
Remove the (2) sensors for turbine vibration | 2.
Remove the (2) thermocouples for oil temperature | 3.
Remove the (2) bearing temperature thermometers | 4.
Remove the turbine speed instrument | 5.
Remove the oil pressure gauge | 6.
Remove the bearing metal cable | 7.
Remove the thermometer for steam temperature | 8.
For bearings 2 and 3
Remove the thermometer on bearing No. 2, western side, 0-100 °C | 1.
Remove the generator cooling air thermometer, eastern side, 0-100 °C | 2.
Remove the right-hand eastern thermometer, 0-100 °C | 3.
Remove the left-hand eastern thermometer, 0-100 °C | 4.
Remove the (2) vibration sensors | 5.
Remove the (2) thermocouples for oil temperature | 6.
For bearing 4
Remove the (2) vibration sensors | 1.
Remove the circular thermometer, 0-100 °C | 2.
Remove a thermocouple for measuring the oil temperature | 3.
Remove a pressure gauge, 0-160, glycerine-filled | 4.
Returning the equipment to service
Refit all the measuring instruments removed from bearings (1), (2), (3), (4) in the same positions as before removal | 1.
Adjust the displacement measuring instrument by adjusting the locking nut of the displacement sensor, measuring the voltage of the displacement converter so that it gives half the 24 Vdc supply voltage, and making sure it gives the correct value (0 mm) on the recorder in the thermal control room, after the turbine maintenance department has mechanically adjusted the turbine shaft position | 2.
Adjust the vibration measuring instruments on the turbine bearings by adjusting the locking nut on the vibration sensor, measuring the voltage of the vibration converter for each bearing so that it gives half the 24 Vdc supply voltage, and making sure it gives the correct value (0 micrometres) on the recorder in the thermal control room | 3.
Reconnect the supply voltage: 380 VAC, 110 Vdc | 4.
Close the work order | 5.
